atlases.a:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one square 3x3 atlas of nine minimal white UI glyphs for a grim post-apocalyptic tabletop interface, Batch 62 Atlas A.
REFERENCE: the supplied atlas is STYLE ONLY. Take only its solid white silhouettes, broad negative-space details and utilitarian shape language. Do not copy any of its subjects. Match the simple single-color weapon silhouettes of the dnd5e UI.
LAYOUT: EXACTLY nine equal square cells, three rows and three columns, strict row-major order below. One independent centered glyph per cell; no borders, no grid lines, no labels. Keep generous margins of at least 15% of every cell, so adjacent silhouettes never meet. Each glyph must read at 16px, 24px and 32px.
STYLE: pure solid white #FFFFFF foreground on clean pure solid black #000000 background. Minimal flat stencil/vector silhouette, crisp edges. Large joined shapes and a few broad cutouts. No shading, gradients, texture, distress, speckles, tiny marks, fine hatching, outlines, decorative badges, logos, letters, numbers or watermark. Serious, practical forms; avoid oversized generic cogs, playful arrows or coins.
ROW 1, left to right:
1. HANDEL / barter: two hands from opposite sides exchanging one wrapped bundle above a plain low crate. The bundle and opposing hands dominate; no coins and no arrows.
2. DOBA / downtime day: sun half-set at a horizon above one small campfire, with one small plain clock face above-right. Clock has two thick hands and NO numerals or tick marks. Use only these three broad silhouettes.
3. BEBESZENIE / salvage from a carcass: a butcher's knife and practical pliers crossed in front of a spare three-rib carcass outline. Tools dominate. No gore, flesh, blood or severed human body.
ROW 2, left to right:
4. SZABROWANIE / scavenging: one crowbar lifting the lid of a battered rectangular crate; two broad scrap pieces fall from the gap. Use broad open negative space.
5. ROZBIORKA / recycling: one practical wrench beside a broken rectangular device, with two large detached bolts. Show dismantling through separated real components, no giant cog and no arrows.
6. WYLACZONY / machine off: a thick open-circle power symbol and vertical power stroke with one unmistakable diagonal slash crossing it. Bold, balanced and readable at 16px.
ROW 3, left to right:
7. EMITER EMP / emitter: bulky homemade handheld emitter in side profile, short muzzle ending in a broad coil or dish, battery pack underneath, one thick cable and crude pistol grip. No detached lightning bolt. Clear distinction from an ordinary pistol.
8. SLO DYCZE / sweets: one partly unwrapped chocolate bar, four chunky chocolate squares exposed and one large folded wrapper. No wrapper writing.
9. CYGARO / cigar: one thick diagonal cigar with a blunt end and one broad short curl of smoke. Plain band without lettering.
Generate the entire atlas as one image, maintaining the exact nine subjects and order.
atlases.b:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one square 3x3 atlas of eight minimal white prewar luxury-item UI glyphs and one EMPTY cell for a post-apocalyptic tabletop interface, Batch 62 Atlas B.
Reference image is STYLE ONLY: solid white practical silhouettes and broad negative space. Do not reuse its actual subjects.
LAYOUT: exactly nine equal square cells, three rows and three columns, in the exact row-major order below. One centered independent glyph per occupied cell, generous blank margins of at least 15% of each cell. Last cell must be completely black. No grid lines, borders, labels, letters or watermark.
STYLE: ONLY pure solid white #FFFFFF on pure solid black #000000. Very simple flat stencil silhouettes. Favor a handful of large joined shapes with a few broad cutouts that remain legible at 16, 24 and 32px. Smooth intact shapes: no scratches, wear, distressed edges, speckles, tiny detached dots, hatching, shading, gradients, photographs, logos, text or numerals. Serious utilitarian objects, not cute cartoon badges.
ROW 1:
1. PRASA / reading matter: one slightly open paperback book, an angled thick cover and just two broad page blocks. No title, no tiny page lines or writing.
2. GRA / games: one small fan of three playing cards, showing only one large plain diamond or heart silhouette each, no ranks or letters. No dice or separate extra pieces.
3. KASETA / cassette and VHS: one rectangular analogue tape cassette with two large spool openings and one thick lower slot, plain exterior without labels.
ROW 2:
4. PLYTA CD / CD disc: one compact disc as a clean circular silhouette, one central hole and one single broad sector of negative space to suggest the disc surface. No jewel box, no lettering, no fine highlights.
5. KONSOLA / console and cartridge: one simple old game controller in front of a single chunky rectangular cartridge. Controller has one thick D-pad and two large plain buttons; no branding or thin cables.
6. ALKOHOL / alcohol: one squat liquor bottle with a short neck, simple stopper and a broad plain blank label panel. No cup, no writing.
ROW 3:
7. ZABAWKA / toy: one simple soft toy teddy bear, rounded head, broad ears and four short limbs, with at most two large dark eye cutouts. It must read as an ordinary object, no cartoon expression, clothing or accessories.
8. PAPIER TOALETOWY / toilet paper: one toilet-paper roll in three-quarter object view, a clearly visible central opening and one broad sheet hanging forward. No floral pattern or tiny perforations.
9. BLANK: leave this cell pure solid black with no glyph at all.
Make one whole atlas with precisely these positions.
